title.narrative: Sustainable Environment and Community Development in Kisumu (SECODE)

description.narrative:
Through assistance and advocacy efforts SECODE II will assist four poor communities in Kisumu with a total number of 121.000 people to obtain an improved environmental situation.
The project will seek to empower the urban poor for them to develop their own representative organisations to be able to take advantage of the democratic system and to claim their rights. Not only for the sake of obtaining tangible improvements of slum areas through a changed municipal pro-poor policy, but also for offering themselves to government agencies as partners.
The SECODE II project will seek to support community-based planning methods to enable communities to prioritise their development goals and mobilize for implementation. Based on these priorities a small grant facility including a saving mechanism will be established to support the local community in demonstrating community driven projects. These projects will illustrate a variety of concrete approaches to sustainable solutions for urban communities.
During the SECODE II project, several community projects will be launched. These projects will demonstrate a variety of concrete approaches to sustainable environment solutions for poor slum communities in Kisumu and inspire to similar projects in other urban areas of Kenya
